summary.para: Provides information about the current game and its Player session through unique identifiers.
Returns the installation ID for this Unity game.
Gets or sets a user identifier supplied by the developer, typically the player's id in a third-party identity provider.
Raised when Identifiers.Identifiers._userId changes value. The argument is the new value of userId. Subscribers are notified after the value is changed.
The Identifiers module implements the Engine API for Identifiers, which provides information about the current game and its player session.
